name: Watertown Mall
summary: Watertown Mall is a modest-sized community shopping center in the Greater Boston area featuring big-box stores and specialty retailers offering apparel, shoes, and jewelry. With convenient hours and a practical tenant mix, it serves as a reliable neighborhood shopping destination for everyday needs.
demographics: Watertown Mall attracts a diverse, middle-income demographic primarily from the Greater Boston area, including families and young professionals from Watertown, Cambridge, and surrounding communities. The trade area serves a well-educated population with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $120,000, drawn by the center's convenient location and mix of value-oriented retailers. Shoppers typically visit for practical, everyday needs including apparel, shoes, and household goods, with strong weekday traffic from local residents and weekend visits from the broader metro area.
description: Watertown Mall is a modest-sized community shopping center located at 550 Arsenal Street in Watertown, Massachusetts, serving the Greater Boston metropolitan area. The center features a practical mix of big-box retailers and specialty shops offering apparel, shoes, jewelry, and other everyday essentials. With operating hours from 9:30 AM to 9:00 PM, the mall provides convenient access for both weekday and weekend shoppers in the densely populated Boston suburbs. The center maintains a solid 3.9-star rating from over 3,500 reviews, reflecting its role as a reliable neighborhood shopping destination. Its strategic location in Watertown, just minutes from Cambridge and downtown Boston, makes it an accessible option for residents seeking value-oriented retail options without the premium pricing of downtown shopping districts.
